independence.context: Standalone task and frozen inputs; no main discussion history, no other reviewer outputs, no revised main drafts
independence.communications: Reported findings to root after independent derivation; root acknowledged F01 and planned a separate finite-model check; this review remains against the frozen snapshot

findings.title: Recursive support can survive withdrawal of its only grounded premise
counterexample: y = a OR z; z = y
a=true gives y=z=true
Retract a
Recompute from old values in either order, even repeatedly: y=z=true
Least grounded fixed point is y=z=false
findings.conclusion_scope: Does not refute P5's acyclic example; refutes unrestricted pointwise recomputation as a complete recursive-support algorithm
findings.revised_claim: For finite acyclic support formulas, affected nodes recomputed in topological order equal fresh evaluation. Positive recursion requires an explicitly selected least-fixed-point or grounded-proof semantics and an appropriate SCC algorithm.
acceptance: Retracting the only root removes both cyclic conclusions
An independent surviving alternative root preserves support

findings.title: P4's unchanged-binding premises omit explicit clock input
counterexample: Accepted = BindingMatches AND observedNow < 10
At observedNow=9, Accepted=true
Append ClockObserved(11); binding, permissions, policy, and retractions unchanged
Accepted=false
findings.conclusion_scope: The prose already recognizes explicit clocks; the theorem premises must match that recognition
findings.revised_claim: Applicability is preserved only when all inputs of the fixed applicability predicate are unchanged; unchanged version binding alone preserves binding compatibility, not temporal or authorization eligibility.

findings.title: Acceptance needs an explicit invariant binding result content version
counterexample: Accept resultId=r, artifactVersion=v1, availabilityRevision=7
Change artifactVersion to v2 while resultId and availabilityRevision stay unchanged
The displayed binding vector still matches an acceptance that only inspected v1
findings.conclusion_scope: Conditional countermodel unless resultId or an immutable witness already fixes content version; no product defect asserted
findings.revised_claim: Acceptance binds immutable content identity, explicit artifactVersion/digest, or an enforced immutable witness reference; availability equivalence alone is insufficient.
acceptance: Content replacement invalidates or explicitly revalidates acceptance
Recovery of identical content does not silently change content identity

findings.title: Admission-time validity needs a specified authorization authority and revocation boundary
counterexample: Kernel caches grant epoch=3 as valid
External authorization authority revokes epoch=3; notification is delayed
Kernel atomically checks local state and admits new work
Local validity does not imply current external-authority validity
findings.conclusion_scope: No counterexample to P7's conflict theorem; obligation when local admission claims external real-time authorization semantics
findings.revised_claim: Validity is guaranteed at a declared authoritative linearization point or within an explicit snapshot/lease policy. External revocation effect requires a specified serialization or propagation contract.
acceptance: Delayed revocation notifications behave according to declared semantics
Revocation between reservation and dispatch triggers the contracted recheck

findings.title: Idempotency and fencing are independent scoped capabilities
counterexample: A valid fencing token can authorize two duplicate increment requests
An idempotent target can accept a new business key from a stale executor when it does not check epochs
findings.conclusion_scope: Avoid interpreting the capability table as a totally ordered enum; the current warning against one safe boolean is sound
findings.revised_claim: Represent independent capabilities scoped to target, operation, identity domain, retention/window, adapter version, and transaction boundary; match required properties rather than ordinal level.
acceptance: A fencing-only adapter is not selected to satisfy duplicate suppression
An idempotency-only adapter is not selected to satisfy stale-writer rejection

findings.title: P15's universal untested-input sentence needs domain and hypothesis-class assumptions
counterexample: The full input domain is {0,1}; both inputs were tested, so no untested input exists
A fixed semantically identical baseline and candidate cannot be forced to differ merely because testing was finite
findings.conclusion_scope: Preserves the main warning that sampled regression evidence alone does not establish unrestricted future improvement
findings.revised_claim: If untested inputs remain and the candidate class permits different behavior there, tests alone cannot distinguish candidates agreeing on observed inputs but differing elsewhere; exhaustive coverage or structural proofs are legitimate additional evidence.
acceptance: The claim explicitly excludes complete finite-domain coverage
Probability claims retain distribution and adaptive-selection assumptions

proof_clarifications.detail: State initial E=U+sum(r_i)+R_remaining<=B explicitly. For settlement c require c+r_i_next<=r_i; reserve any new cleanup obligation during admission. This clarifies the invariant proof and is not a demonstrated real-cost overrun counterexample.
Specify duplicate-sensitive effects and an environment in which a retried request can eventually succeed; permanent external unavailability is a different liveness failure.
Child guarantees need compatible versions and time windows. Separately observed world predicates do not necessarily hold simultaneously.

accepted_tradeoffs: Ledger knowledge is not instantaneous external-world truth
P7 is an admission-point property and not an all-times active-count invariant
Unknown effects remain unresolved until suitable evidence or a declared recovery policy
Threshold budgets are useful weaker contracts when no credible hard cost bound exists
Exploratory acceptance can retain human judgment
Finite acyclic support and a single authority are legitimate first-slice scope limits

validation.method: model reasoning and traces that a human can check by hand; no human review performed
